budget_items.topic: Certified free cash and retained earnings
budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Town Accountant reported that the Department of Revenue certified free cash and retained earnings, with four amounts listed.
budget_items.quote: ms. brochu informed the board that free cash and retained earnings have been certified by the department of revenue.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Town Manager reported no figures had changed since the Special Town Meeting Warrant briefing; listed adjustments total $73,000.
The Town Manager said a surplus, pending New Growth numbers, could be used for Marshall Park or the Special Purpose Stabilization account; no amount was given.
budget_items.quote: anticipates a surplus which could be used for marshall park, or the special purpose stabilization account.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The DPW director will seek capital plan funding to complete the fleet at about $525,000 per year.
budget_items.quote: funding from the capital plan to complete the fleet at about $525,000 per year to fund those trucks

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The DPW director estimated sidewalk repair will cost $400,000, under a five-year plan.
budget_items.quote: mr. bernard estimates sidewalk repair will cost $400,000.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The DPW director estimated $300,000 to replace the sewer pump stations and add SCADA monitoring.
budget_items.quote: he estimates $300,000 to replace the stations and incorporate scada to monitor

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The superintendent reported the primary school AC project, appropriated $230,000, was largely underestimated.
budget_items.quote: for which $230,000 was appropriated was largely underestimated.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The school department presented six FY24 capital requests, including window film, doors, security, fire alarm, a feasibility study and a truck.
The primary school seeks $618,500 in capital spending over ten years.
budget_items.quote: the primary school seeks $618,500 in capital spending.

budget_items.topic: Turkey Hill Elementary ten-year capital needs
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Turkey Hill Elementary School needs total $15,056,822 in capital requests, which assumes MSBA contributions; a possible $2,200,000 for the MS/HS turf, walls and concession stand was also noted.
budget_items.quote: turkey hill elementary school needs include $15,056,822

budget_items.topic: District-wide ten-year safety film and vehicles
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Over ten years the schools plan $343,923 on safety film for windows, plus a mower, two pickups, plows and a van.
budget_items.quote: the schools plan to spend $343,923 on safety film

budget_items.what_was_recorded: ESSER funding ends in 2024 and the school department is tracking positions to eliminate; no dollar figure was given and municipal funding is not available for those positions.
budget_items.quote: well aware that municipal funding is not available to cover the positions

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The school department requested ARPA funding for sidewalks leading to the schools; no amount was given.
budget_items.quote: the school department requested funding for sidewalks leading toward the elementary and middle/high schools.
